scope: Replacement artwork for existing local farm decorations; no DB or Storage changes
normalization: Uniform contain resize to transparent 512px PNG; source and resized RGBA retained without recoloring or background removal. Registration uses alpha >=4 to ignore invisible dust, with 8px extra margin around the silhouette.

items.prompt: Create ONE production-ready transparent 2D game prop sprite: a mature, broad-canopied deciduous farm tree. The attached windmill image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match its lovingly hand-painted storybook game rendering, subtle material texture, delicate warm brown contour, soft dimensional shading and warm ambient daylight. Do not draw or modify the windmill. Art direction: a gently toned-down palette of dusty olive and sage leaves, muted moss shadows, warm gray-brown weathered bark, small natural cream highlights; slightly less saturated than the reference. Rich organic leaf clusters with individually suggested leaves, asymmetrical natural branches, visibly textured trunk and roots. Friendly, grounded, artisanal, not glossy or photorealistic. Camera: orthographic front view with slightly elevated overhead visibility, a horizontal ground contact, appropriate beside the reference in a square-grid cozy farming game; no diamond/isometric base. A single tree, full canopy and roots visible, no chopped branches at image boundaries, centered with generous transparent margins. Sparse tiny tufts at the roots only, no scenery, no grass island or solid ground slab, no large cast shadow, no labels or text. Genuine clean alpha transparency, not a checkerboard or colored backdrop. Square image.

textures.prompt: Create ONE seamless tileable square terrain MATERIAL TEXTURE for a cozy hand-painted farm game. Attached windmill is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY for warm natural mineral texture and subtly illustrated painterly rendering; DO NOT depict the windmill or any object. Full-bleed flat orthographic overhead view of softly worn, compacted dusty farm path soil. Quiet low-saturation warm taupe, mushroom beige, gray-brown earth with subtle dry fine-grain flecks, numerous tiny irregular embedded weathered sand-colored pebbles and a few delicate worn scuffs. Small gravel occupies less than 8 percent of the surface. Very restrained natural tonal variation distributed uniformly across the whole texture. Fine detailed painted earth and mineral grain that reads at small game scale, harmonious with the windmill's stone and wood, not photographic and not flat vector. Absolutely no large round patches or circular stains, no big rocks, cobbles, flagstones, planks, grass, plants, leaves, cracks, footprints, objects, borders, bevel, tile edges, shadows, raised earth block, grid, scenery or text. Texture fills every edge, even diffuse illumination, no vignette or central highlight. Four edges should tile seamlessly. OPAQUE image, no transparency.
